title: The yard from the ridge
logline: The mill from above, from the ridge, 1994: the yard, the pond, the stack, the town beyond it, the bay. The only page in the sequence drawn from where the glow will be. It doesn't know that yet.

panels.composition: From a wooded ridge looking down: a mill yard with a pond and a smoking stack, a small town beyond it and a gray bay, fir branches at the frame's edges, black spotting in the near trees.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, looking down from a wooded ridge onto a lumber mill yard with a log pond and a smoking stack, a small town beyond and a gray bay, fir branches at the frame's edges, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: From where the glow will be.
